arguments:
{"script":"set -e
mkdir -p cpu_check_workspace
cd cpu_check_workspace

# 1) Record system identity and environment
(
  echo "--- hostnamectl ---"
  hostnamectl 2>/dev/null || echo "(hostnamectl not available)"
  echo
  echo "--- uname -a ---"
  uname -a
  echo
  echo "--- /etc/os-release ---"
  cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo "--- date ---"
  date
  echo
  echo "--- whoami ---"
  whoami
  echo
  echo "--- id ---"
  id
  echo
  echo "--- env ---"
  env
) > env_metadata.txt

# 2) Collect CPU-related raw outputs
(
  echo "--- lscpu ---"
  lscpu 2>/dev/null || echo "(lscpu not available)"
  echo
  echo "--- lscpu -J ---"
  lscpu -J 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo "--- /proc/cpuinfo ---"
  cat /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
  echo "--- nproc ---"
  nproc 2>/dev/null || true
) > raw_cpu_data.txt

# Create verified backup with integrity checks
cp raw_cpu_data.txt raw_cpu_data_backup.txt
sha256sum raw_cpu_data.txt raw_cpu_data_backup.txt > sha256sums.txt
if [ "$(sha256sum raw_cpu_data.txt | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum raw_cpu_data_backup.txt | awk '{print $1}')" ]; then
  echo "VERIFICATION: MATCH" >> sha256sums.txt
else
  echo "VERIFICATION: MISMATCH" >> sha256sums.txt
fi

# 3) Parse and normalize into cpu_report_preparation.txt and flag inconsistencies
cpu_count_nproc=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || true)
lscpu_out=$(lscpu 2>/dev/null || true)
cpus_lscpu=$(echo "$lscpu_out" | awk -F: '/^CPU\(s\):/ {gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}')
cores_per_socket=$(echo "$lscpu_out" | awk -F: '/Core\(s\) per socket:/ {gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}')
sockets=$(echo "$lscpu_out" | awk -F: '/Socket\(s\):/ {gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}')
threads_per_core=$(echo "$lscpu_out" | awk -F: '/Thread\(s\) per core:/ {gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}')
model_name=$(awk -F: '/model name/ {print $2; exit}' /proc/cpuinfo | sed 's/^ *//')
proc_processor_count=$(grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || true)

{
  echo "CPU_COUNT_NPROC: ${cpu_count_nproc:-unknown}"
  echo "CPU_S_from_lscpu: ${cpus_lscpu:-unknown}"
  echo "CORES_PER_SOCKET: ${cores_per_socket:-unknown}"
  echo "SOCKETS: ${sockets:-unknown}"
  echo "THREADS_PER_CORE: ${threads_per_core:-unknown}"
  echo "MODEL_NAME: ${model_name:-unknown}"
  echo "PROC_CPUINFO_PROCESSOR_LINES: ${proc_processor_count:-unknown}"
  echo
  echo "INCONSISTENCIES:"
  if [ -n "${cpus_lscpu}" ] && [ -n "${cpu_count_nproc}" ] && [ "${cpus_lscpu}" -ne "${cpu_count_nproc}" ]; then echo " - lscpu CPU(s) (${cpus_lscpu}) != nproc (${cpu_count_nproc})"; fi
  if [ -n "${proc_processor_count}" ] && [ -n "${cpu_count_nproc}" ] && [ "${proc_processor_count}" -ne "${cpu_count_nproc}" ]; then echo " - /proc/cpuinfo processor lines (${proc_processor_count}) != nproc (${cpu_count_nproc})"; fi
  if [ -z "${cpus_lscpu}" ] && [ -z "${proc_processor_count}" ]; then echo " - No CPU counts found in lscpu or /proc/cpuinfo"; fi
  echo
  echo "READY_FOR_EXTRACTION: yes"
} > cpu_report_preparation.txt

# Output the number of CPUs (logical processors)
echo "${cpu_count_nproc:-0}"
"}
